assembly.qualification: Publication wrapper and explicit links are new; original execution dates, engine/index lineage and observations are preserved. Source documents are untouched.

comparisonSummary.methodology: Three completed repeatable verification runs precede representative exact node/edge SQL comparison and exhaustive bounded classification. SQL opens disposable DB+WAL copies only. No source reads, index lifecycle calls, corpus edits or semantic-correctness inference.

limits.scope: JS heap is not total RSS; snapshot hashing/copying are byte-bounded, not covered by helper timeouts. At most one pair of temporary copies exists at a time.

comparisonSummary.benchmarkCaps: Caps are read from each process record, including values above 600 seconds. They do not change the three-completed-run qualification. The helper timeout is a separate diagnostic limit.
comparisonSummary.engineIdentityQualification: Run engine directory labels and corpus revisions are retained; frozen engine content seals and code revisions must be supplied separately by the campaign record. No engine files are hashed here.

streamSummary.method: Ordered streaming merge of exact semantic rows; nodes exclude updated_at; edges exclude surrogate ID. Same-identity changes include raw metadata and provenance. No source reads or resolution precision inference.
streamSummary.digestFormat: SHA256 of newline-delimited recursively key-sorted JSON raw rows, in SQLite BINARY identity order; modified rows contribute [before,after]. These are not the campaign fingerprint algorithm.
streamSummary.aggregateOverflowPolicy: Any excess distinct aggregate key contributes to explicit __overflow_other__; totals remain exhaustive and no category accuracy is inferred.

additionSamples.method: SHA256 bottom-2 edge identities per stratum; retain the 128 lowest SHA256 stratum keys. Deterministic, not random or statistically representative.

streamSummary.precisionScope: All differences counted and aggregate-classified; only listed samples can receive later source review. No all-additions correctness claim.
streamSummary.integrityScope: This helper does not replace separate integrity_check, foreign_key_check and page-count diagnostics.

qualification: The original exact helper stopped classification at its 100000 semantic-delta-row guard; that status is preserved. The separate bounded streaming classifier completed both core comparisons and agrees with all recorded SQL EXCEPT projections. Every anomaly row and every selected sample is retained. The 24 anomaly records span two comparisons and may overlap; they are not asserted to be 24 unique source defects. Counts, aggregate labels, retained samples and synthetic smoke are not automatic source verdicts or global precision/recall certification. The separately published intermediate-204 source review is complete: 99 selected additions are supported, and 14 distinct removals comprise 12 supported removals and two confirmed constructor regressions. This is neither whole-graph certification nor evidence for candidate172 without its separate comparisons. Both full-GHC exact comparisons are skipped because neither arm has three qualified complete full-scope runs.
